checks: Repository picker identity, full-row hover/right/center clicks and actual unmatched-search path open the genuine native folder dialog.
Native folder cancellation preserves the displayed/effective selection; choosing a different existing valid Git directory visibly updates the path and its complete tooltip.
Cancel and Escape from the focused worktree modal return actual typing to the original terminal without an assisting prompt click; original PID/nonexported marker/cwd remain intact.

Submitting an actual terminal worktree creates exactly one additional worktree with expected HEAD/common Git directory and a different shell; typing reaches that new tab without an assisting prompt click.
Returning to the original tab gives fresh same-PID/marker/cwd output and a clean source checkout, verified independently from Git snapshots.

English/German, Dark/Light, normal/narrow: repository identity, readable tooltip and footer interaction remain reachable; app-language restart establishes a fresh baseline rather than claiming cross-restart shell survival.
limits: No genuine managed-agent or subscription acceptance without real isolated profiles.
Each native session has an explicitly frozen scope and less-than-480-second operator budget; failed or untested cases are retained, never waived.
